EN: The people of Filly are in dire need of medicine. There are rumours of a traveling chem-merchant wandering nearby. You should have no trouble tracking them down.
ZH: 菲利镇的居民急需药品。有传言说附近有一位旅行药物商人。你应该很容易就能找到他。

EN: That abandoned Vault stocked with supplies? That's Deathclaw territory now. How he got in there, nobody knows, but you won't get to the stash without facing him first. Time to break out the big guns!
ZH: 废弃的避难所里有许多物资？那里现在是死爪的领地了。没人知道死爪是怎么进去的，但想拿到物资储备肯定先得对付它，是时候拿出杀手锏了。

EN: A Dweller told me that Maxson's Roughnecks made their way to the Wilson Atomatoys Factory. That should be my next stop.
ZH: 一个居民告诉我“麦克森硬汉小队”去了威尔逊原子玩具厂。我下一站就去那里。

EN: An underground military base is under attack and calling in all their Wasteland patrols. Could it be the Pests again? We need to stop them! But we'll need Military Fatigues to pass as one of the patrols and get into the base...
ZH: 一个地下军事基地遭到攻击，召唤他们所有的废土巡逻前去帮忙。难道又是“害虫”吗？我们需要阻止他们！但我们需要军装来通过他们的巡逻并进入基地……

EN: No dogs here. Try our sister Vault: 899. They're classier. But first, take this as our token of thanks.
ZH: 这里没有狗。试试他们的姐妹避难所吧：899号。他们更经典。但首先，拿着这个吧，当做是我们的感谢。

EN: The Raiders mentioned Bigsby may have fled to Vault 199. I should go ask around. Hopefully, the Dwellers have him.
ZH: 掠夺者有提到比格斯比可能逃到了199号避难所。我应该帮你问问。但愿它在居民那里。

EN: I remember those! We survived the blast, but the radiation still got us. When you're this old, who cares about wrinkles, right?
ZH: 我记得那些！我们从大爆炸中幸存了下来，但还是没能躲过辐射的影响。当你已经这把年纪了，谁还在乎皱纹呐？

EN: While out exploring, one of your Dwellers found an old advertisement for Vault 789. Time to check it out!
ZH: 外出探险时，居民中的一员发现了一则给789号避难所的旧广告。去查看一下吧！

EN: Paula Plumbkin turned out to be an evil Raider wannabe, but at least she gave us the location of Vault 525, otherwise known as Vaultopolis!
ZH: 宝拉·普朗布金到头来其实是一个邪恶的掠夺者。但至少她告诉了我们525号避难所的位置。

EN: I guess we traded Jack for a pet, or Jack traded himself, or something! But he ended up married to a Raider Boss named Kaela who hangs out in a cave...
ZH: 我猜我们把杰克卖了换了个宠物，或者杰克把自己卖了或者其他什么鬼。但是他最后居然和一个住在洞穴里名叫凯拉的掠夺者首领结了婚……

EN: We've just received news that a nearby Vault has descended into chaos. It seems fans of pre-war science-fiction novelettes have come to blows over which series is the best. We need to send a team to help pacify the Vault!
ZH: 我们刚刚收到消息说附近的避难所陷入了混乱。似乎那些战前科幻小说的粉丝们已经为哪部最好大打出手了。我们需要派一支队伍去安抚避难所！

EN: You came across a small secluded cabin while adventuring in the Wasteland. Perhaps you should see what's inside.
ZH: 你在废土探险时发现了一个小而隐蔽的小屋。也许你该看看里面有什么。

EN: A duet of singing Raiders has been spreading terror in the Wasteland using high production value musical numbers. We need to ring down the curtain on these musical thugs!
ZH: 一对会唱歌的掠夺者用高水准的音乐节目在废土上散播恐怖。我们得让这些音乐暴徒谢幕！

EN: Does the “magical” water really work or is it a total sham?  We need to track down this Water Wizard and see if he's the real deal or a snake oil salesman.
ZH: “神奇”水真的有效还是完全假的？我们需要追踪这个水之术士，看看他是不是真正的商人还是卖大力丸的骗子。

EN: The notorious Raider, Sally Switchblade, is getting married to the infamous Marcus Hammer. But they're both having second thoughts, because neither wants to live the Raider lifestyle anymore. If only they'd communicate! Bust in and solve their problems for them.
ZH: 臭名昭著的掠夺者“刀锋萨莉”准备和另一个声名狼藉的掠夺者“铁锤马克斯”结婚了。但双方都还有点犹豫，因为他们都不想再作为掠夺者生活了。问题是他们根本不知道该怎么交流！赶紧介入帮他们解决问题吧。

EN: I've discovered a map leading to Vault 242, where the “Dwellers” were all creatures rather than humans. I should follow the map and unlock the secrets this Vault has to offer.
ZH: 我们已经发现了通往242号避难所的地图，这个避难所里的“居民”不是人类而是各种生物。我该跟着地图然后解开关于这个避难所的秘密。

EN: Coach is out there. Somewhere. Watching. Taunting. When we find him, we find Rackie Jobinson's Jersey!
ZH: 教练还在外面，某个地方。看着，嘲笑着我们。当我们找到他的时候，我们就能找到罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫了！

EN: Now Big Wes wants you to kill a Mole rat brood mother, with one catch. You can only use pistols. Good luck piercing moleskin with those!
ZH: 现在大维斯要你杀掉一只鼹鼠巢母，但有个附加条件：你只能用手枪。祝你能用那些手枪打穿鼹鼠皮吧！

EN: Thirteen searches, thirteen failures. How unlucky! For the fourteenth attempt, we'll search the ruins of Vault 701.
ZH: 13次搜索，13次失败。太不幸了！第十四次尝试，我们会前往701号避难所废墟。

EN: Coach wasn't at the Wilson Automatoys factory, but maybe he's getting in a workout in the ruins of Madden's Gym!
ZH: 教练不在威尔逊原子玩具厂，但是也许他在麦登健身房里锻炼！

EN: Said there were some settlers that had been kidnapped by Raiders. They're in Vault 778. Here, take this uniform. I sure won't need it.
ZH: 据说一些定居者被掠夺者绑架了。他们在778号避难所。给，拿着这件制服。我反正用不上了。

EN: A group of settlers is stuck in a Mole rat den. Word is, they have info on Preston Garvey. Go help them out of their jam!
ZH: 一群定居者被困在鼹鼠巢穴里。据说他们有关于普雷斯顿·加维的消息。快去帮他们脱困吧！

EN: Henrietta was Coach's old girlfriend. She doesn't know where he is, but gave us a sweet weapon to help take him down. The search goes on!
ZH: 亨丽埃塔是教练的前女友。她不知道他在哪里，但她给了一个很赞的武器来帮助你拿下他。继续寻找吧！

EN: I've found a ransom note written by a Raider Boss named Willard Glover. He says he's captured a settler and taken him to the nearby Corvega Factory.
ZH: 我们找到了一条赎金字条，落款是掠夺者头目威拉德·格洛弗。他说他抓了一个定居者，把人带到了附近的可伟佳装配厂。

EN: Famed scientist Otto von Hurfburg is nearby, researching the mating habits of Radscorpions. Make sure he's not in over his head.
ZH: 著名科学家欧拓凡霍夫伯格就在附近，正在研究辐射蝎的交配习惯，请确保他的安全。

EN: Famed scientist Otto von Hurfburg is nearby, searching for a modern-day Fountain of Youth. Find him, and learn what he's discovered!
ZH: 著名科学家欧拓凡霍夫伯格就在附近，正在研究现代社会永葆青春的方法。找到他，看看他有什么发现。

EN: Famed scientist Otto von Hurfburg is nearby, working on a Mr. Handy capable of exploring space. See what he's discovered!
ZH: 著名科学家欧拓凡霍夫伯格就在附近，正在研究可以探索太空的巧手先生，去看看他的进展吧！

EN: No luck in the pencil factory, but we're not discouraged. Rackie Jobinson's Jersey will be ours! We'll search the old Hubris Comics store.
ZH: 铅笔厂里也没有。但我们并不气馁。棒球衫一定是我们的！我们去“虎不理漫画”漫画店看看吧。

EN: ASSIGN DWELLERS HERE TO MINE ULTRACITE ORE. THE ORE CAN BE USED TO CRAFT WEAPONS AT THE ULTRACITE WEAPON WORKSHOP
ZH: 在此分配居民开采辐射极琉矿矿石。矿石可在辐射极琉矿武器工坊中用于制造武器

EN: Vault-Tec has assigned you to the Ultracite Fever experiment! The Ultracite deposits under your Vault will attract an army of vicious Scorched. Mine Ultracite to craft powerful Ultracite Weapons, and extend some classic Vault-Tec hospitality. Don't worry, any dwellers who perish in these attacks will be revived free of charge! Good luck, Overseer, and don't forget to smile!
ZH: 避难所科技将您分配到辐射极琉矿狂热实验中！您避难所下方的辐射极琉矿矿床将吸引一支凶残的辐尸人大军。开采辐射极琉矿以打造强大的辐射极琉矿武器，同时展示一下避难所科技的传统好客之道。别担心，在这些袭击中牺牲的居民将免费复活！祝您好运，监督者，别忘了保持微笑！

EN: Test your skills as Overseer in this season's new Experimental Vault! Experimental Vaults introduce fresh twists and unique rewards. Seasons only last a short time - don't miss out!
ZH: 在本赛季新实验避难所中考验您作为监督者的实力！实验避难所引入全新玩法和独家奖励。赛季时间有限——千万别错过！
